from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


def _load(name: str, relative: str):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, ROOT / relative)
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def _readonly_result():
    return {
        "status": "READ_ONLY_COMPLETE",
        "tests": "PASS",
        "quality_gate": "PASS",
        "production_touched": False,
        "blockers": [],
        "percent_complete": 100,
        "checks": [
            {
                "type": "sql_readonly_audit",
                "status": "PASS",
                "sql_evidence": {
                    "status": "PASS",
                    "mode": "READ_ONLY_SQL",
                    "connection": "readonly_sql_connection:default",
                    "evidence": [
                        {
                            "name": "metadata",
                            "columns": ["object_name", "password_hash"],
                            "rows": [["Servidores_Conexiones", "must-not-publish"]],
                            "row_count_returned": 1,
                            "truncated": False,
                        }
                    ],
                },
            }
        ],
    }


def test_readonly_complete_certifies_only_with_evidence():
    publisher = _load("worker_result_publisher_readonly", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_result_publisher.py")
    result = _readonly_result()
    evidence = publisher.certification_evidence(result)
    assert evidence["certification"] == "CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY"
    assert evidence["work_completion"] == "COMPLETE"
    assert evidence["percent_complete"] == 100

    result["checks"] = []
    evidence = publisher.certification_evidence(result)
    assert evidence["certification"] == "NOT_CERTIFIED"
    assert evidence["percent_complete"] == 95


def test_readonly_publication_redacts_sensitive_column_values():
    publisher = _load("worker_result_publisher_redaction", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_result_publisher.py")
    public = publisher.sanitize(_readonly_result())
    assert public["certification"] == "CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY"
    row = public["sql_readonly_evidence"]["checks"][0]["evidence"][0]["rows"][0]
    assert row == ["Servidores_Conexiones", "[REDACTED]"]
    assert "must-not-publish" not in json.dumps(public)


def test_readonly_marker_can_promote_not_certified(tmp_path):
    publisher = _load("worker_result_publisher_marker", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_result_publisher.py")
    marker = tmp_path / "job.json"
    marker.write_text("certification=NOT_CERTIFIED\n", encoding="utf-8")
    assert publisher.marker_satisfied(marker, {"certification": "CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY"}) is False
    marker.write_text("certification=CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY\n", encoding="utf-8")
    assert publisher.marker_satisfied(marker, {"certification": "CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY"}) is True


def test_dispatcher_preserves_structured_sql_evidence(monkeypatch):
    dispatcher = _load("worker_dispatcher_readonly", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_dispatcher.py")
    payload = {
        "status": "PASS",
        "mode": "READ_ONLY_SQL",
        "connection": "readonly_sql_connection:default",
        "evidence": [{"name": "x", "columns": ["a"], "rows": [[1]], "row_count_returned": 1, "truncated": False}],
    }
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        dispatcher,
        "run",
        lambda *args, **kwargs: subprocess.CompletedProcess(args=[], returncode=0, stdout=json.dumps(payload)),
    )
    result = dispatcher.run_check(ROOT, {"type": "sql_readonly_audit", "queries": [{"name": "x", "sql": "SELECT 1"}]})
    assert result["status"] == "PASS"
    assert result["sql_evidence"] == payload
    assert result["output"] == "SQL_READONLY_AUDIT=PASS"


def test_integrated_certification_path_remains_non_readonly():
    publisher = _load("worker_result_publisher_integrated", "tools/mirror_sync/universal_job_result_publisher.py")
    result = {"status": "BLOCKED", "percent_complete": 80}
    evidence = publisher.certification_evidence(result)
    assert evidence["certification"] == "NOT_CERTIFIED"
    assert evidence["percent_complete"] == 80
